fields.description: Pierside Marina Residences is a marina-side apartment collection on Sobha Siniya Island. One- and two-bedroom homes sit alongside larger three-bedroom duplexes, with different outlooks across the water and landscaped community. The brochure marks Tower C as fully furnished; the other towers require their own specification checks.

overview: Three-bedroom Type C is a duplex with a maid’s room and powder room. One- and two-bedroom variants differ in balcony area and outlook; no single marina view is promised for every apartment.
research.locationNote: Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. Island golf, marina and leisure facilities are wider master-community amenities; their access and opening arrangements need confirmation.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 1,520,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder offers a 20/40/40 option and a separate 20% booking plus 80% during construction option. The table transcribes the first. A current developer unit schedule and any final balance must be confirmed.
